tutorials.name: Canonical Data Model Pattern
tutorials.shortDesc: The canonical data model design pattern reduces the required number of point-to-point message flows when integrating multiple input and output applications which each communicate using different data formats or protocols. This is achieved by converting data into and out of a canonical data format before and after the core transformation tasks.
